mapper.select: /* QnA 목록 조회 */ SELECT i.inquiry_id , i.answer_status , c.code_item_name AS category_name , i.title , i.question_content , u.user_name , i.user_id , i.created_at , i.visible_yn FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN code_item c ON i.question_type_id = c.code_item_id LEFT JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: /* QnA 문의 등록 */ INSERT INTO inquiry ( question_type_id, title, question_content, user_id, visible_yn, answer_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{qnaCategoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{isVisible}, '답변대기', NOW() )
